fields.name: Grimhilde
fields.description: Leathery, slipping skin. Twitchy and unsettling. Very long fingernails.
fields.unique_thing: I am the last remnant of an ancient necromantic culture, dug out of a bog and displayed for years in a museum.
fields.gear_notes:
Flap of demonic neck skin
Rusty nail

backgrounds.name: Displayed in a museum for years

spells.name: Chant of Endings
spells.desc:
Target: The nearby enemy with the fewest hit points (you choose if there’s a tie; you also don’t have to be able to see that enemy)
Attack: Intelligence + Level vs. MD (+5)
Hit: 1d10 + Intelligence necro damage.

spells.name: Command Undead
spells.desc:
Target: One nearby undead creature with 64 hp or fewer
3rd level spell Target with 96 hp or fewer.
5th level spell Target with 160 hp or fewer.
7th level spell Target with 266 hp or fewer.
9th level spell Target with 460 hp or fewer.

Attack: Intelligence + Level vs. MD
Hit: The target is confused (hard save ends, 16+).
ADV FEAT: Miss does not expend spell

spells.name: Unholy Blast
spells.desc:
Target: One nearby enemy
Attack: Intelligence + Level vs. PD
Hit: 4d6 + Intelligence negative energy damage.
First Miss: Half damage, and make the attack again against an enemy you haven’t already targeted with unholy blast this turn.
Second Miss: Half damage, or full damage if the escalation die is 1+ and you choose to decrease it by 1.

spells.name: Summon Undead
spells.desc:
Effect: You summon a mob of 1d3 + 1 crumbling skeleton mooks. These skeletons fight for you until the end of the battle or until they drop to 0 hp, whichever comes first.

1st level mook [undead]
Initiative: +6 / Vulnerability: holy
Attack: Sword +6 vs. AC  (ADV FEAT: First attack gets extra +CHA vs AC)
Hit: 3 dmg +CHA
Resist weapons 16+: When a weapon attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.
AC 16, PD 14, MD 10, HP 6 (mook)
Mook: One mook dies for every 6 damage you dealt to the mob

features.name: Summoning
features.desc: You are able to summon creatures

talents.name: Cackling Soliloquist
talents.desc:
Spend all actions when casting a /arc spell, spell recharges 18+ after battle + invent a slight improvement to spell.
ADV FEAT: Also gain 1d6 + LVL + CHA temp HP.

talents.name: Redeemer
talents.desc:
Summoned undead are released from service > fight harder for you.
Minions: On death release CHA * 1d4 holy burst to all engaged, atks deal +CHA holy dmg.
ADV FEAT: The first time each battle an undead creature you have summoned attacks, it gains an attack bonus equal to your Charisma modifier

talents.name: Death Priest
talents.desc:
Icon connections can be conversations with the dead. Also can use Seance 1/arc when not in battle.
Seance: Short rite to contact dead related to random non-Lich Queen icon. GM rolls in secret, on 1-2 info is wrong

kinPowers.name: Resourceful
kinPowers.desc: You have a bonus feat of the highest tier you qualify for.
